# Scōp

> Scōp is a UK all in one daily supplement powder from Scōp Supplement Ltd. One 11 g scoop of Daybreak Orange (orange flavour) mixed into 300 to 400 ml of cold water provides 14 ingredients, each with its dose printed: 5,000 mg creatine monohydrate, 400 mg magnesium (as bisglycinate), vitamin D3 100 µg (4,000 IU), vitamin K2 MK-7 100 µg, all eight B vitamins in active forms, 750 mg reduced glutathione and 500 mg moringa leaf extract. A 330 g pouch holds 30 servings. Subscription £39 a month (about £1.30 a day), pause or cancel any time; one-off pouch £49. Made in the UK, suitable for vegetarians, no caffeine, no proprietary blends.

Scōp is built to cover performance and everyday wellness in one product: creatine for training alongside the core vitamins and minerals, with vitamin D 100 µg (4,000 IU), vitamin B6 10 mg and magnesium 400 mg, each dosed at the top of NHS guidance for adults taking supplements. It is not a greens powder and contains no probiotics or adaptogens.
